title: ...lose power during a severe winter or summer storm
desc: Keep your home safe, protect electronics, and preserve food supplies.
todos: Keep refrigerator and freezer doors closed tightly to maintain cold temps.
Unplug sensitive electronics and appliances to prevent power surge damage.
Use battery-powered flashlights instead of candles to reduce fire hazards.
Report power outage immediately to local utility company provider.
Check on vulnerable neighbors, elderly family members, or pet needs.
